Adds peafowl only in chicken/turkey poultry habitat. Existing animals and births are unaffected.

Nearby ducks before natural spawning stops

Allow new natural duck spawns only when the resulting local total stays within this number, within 75 tiles. Counts adults, ducklings and player-bred ducks. Default 4; 0 disables natural duck spawning. Does not remove animals or limit births.
Counts all living geese, including young and captive birds within 75 tiles. Zero disables new natural spawns; never removes birds or limits births.
Counts all living peafowl, including young and captive birds within 75 tiles. Zero disables new natural spawns; never removes birds or limits births.

Scale both domestic and Wood duck chances using the vanilla Animal Spawn Chance setting. The vanilla "Never" setting disables new ducks while this option is on. Duck density multipliers: Extremely Rare 5 percent, Rare 15 percent, Sometimes 35 percent, Often 60 percent, Very Often 85 percent, Always 100 percent. These are this mod's multipliers.

Chance that an eligible 100 x 100 tile shoreline block receives a Wood Duck, Green-winged Teal, Blue-winged Teal, Gadwall or American Black Duck pair from one shared budget, before the vanilla multiplier. Default 10 percent. Each block has a saved stable roll.
